title: A smooth finite modification of a reduced curve
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and let $X$ be a reduced separated scheme of finite type over $k$ with $\dim X\le1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then there exist a separated scheme $X^
u$ of finite type over $k$ with $\dim X^
u\le1$ which is smooth over $k$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], a finite morphism of $k$-schemes $
u:X^
u	o X$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and a dense open subscheme $X'\subseteq X$ such that $
u$ restricts to an isomorphism $
u^{-1}(X')	o X'$. (One may take for $
u$ the normalization of $X$, the disjoint union of the normalizations [def-sc-normalization] of the irreducible components of $X$ with their reduced structure.)

source.place: Varieties, Lemma 0BXR (lemma-normalization-locally-algebraic: nu finite, X^nu a disjoint union of normal irreducible schemes, nu birational for X reduced) and Lemma 0B8Y (lemma-regular-point-on-curve: normal one-dimensional over a perfect field is smooth), as used in Etale Cohomology, proof of Lemma 0A3Q (lemma-somewhat-easier)

mathlib_searches.query: normalization of a reduced curve over an algebraically closed field is finite and smooth

mathlib_searches.query: normalization of a one-dimensional reduced scheme of finite type over a perfect field is a finite morphism from a smooth scheme, isomorphism over a dense open

mathlib_searches.results: Normalization.lean:611 instance [Smooth g] : IsIso (f.normalizationPullback g) (normalization commutes with smooth base change); ZariskisMainTheorem.lean: exists_isIso_morphismRestrict_toNormalization (iso to the normalization over an open, for quasi-finite points), IsFinite.of_isProper_of_locallyQuasiFinite.
